entries.name: VISR
entries.description: Native Metal port of Halo: Combat Evolved for Apple Vision Pro and other Apple devices. Head-tracked stereo, foveated rendering, a 3D theater screen and PlayStation VR2 Sense controller aiming. Bring your own disc image of the original Xbox release.

screenshots.alt: VISR: the app icon, a helmet with a gold visor, beside the VISR wordmark on a dark teal grid

entries.status_notes: Plays in a window beside your apps, in 3D or in 2D like the original, with a gamepad; played on Apple Vision Pro. Full and Progressive VR are in the app behind an experimental switch, untested on a headset.
entries.description: The Wind Waker in a window beside your apps on Apple Vision Pro, with the Great Sea rebuilt in real 3D behind the glass every frame, so you can lean in and look around Outset. Or switch it to 2D, like the GameCube. A native visionOS port of SwitchWaker. Bring your own disc.

screenshots.alt: Link on Outset Island's pier, in a window floating in a living room
Link on Windfall Island's dock, in a window seen from off to one side: he and the cliffs stand out of the sea behind the glass

entries.name: Lambda VisionPro

credits.name: Lambda1VR (DrBeef)
credits.role: Inspiration (Quest VR port); no code reused

entries.status_notes: Playable end to end on Apple Vision Pro, per the README. The hand-tracked VR input is described there as proof-of-concept quality: functional, with rough edges.
entries.description: Half-Life in full immersion on Apple Vision Pro: the Xash3D-FWGS engine with its ref_gl renderer on Metal through ANGLE, presented with Compositor Services, with hand-tracked weapons and locomotion. Bring your own Half-Life from Steam (the pre-25th-anniversary build).

entries.status_notes: Plays on Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 27) in full and progressive immersion, with PS VR2 Sense controllers or bare hands. Window mode (third person, gamepad) is newer: characters look a little flatter than in the game.
entries.description: Twilight Princess in first person on Apple Vision Pro: JoeyAW's TPVR mod on Dusklight, built natively for visionOS. Full or progressive immersion with PS VR2 Sense controllers or bare hands, or the GameCube game in a window beside your apps, with real depth. Bring your own disc.

screenshots.alt: Link at Ordon Ranch, in a window floating in a living room
Ordon Ranch in first person: the ranch house, goats and a rancher, with the HUD floating ahead
The same window seen from the side: Link and the ranch house have real depth behind the glass

entries.status_notes: Runs on the headset itself; the curator installed it from scratch with this copy's guide (Steam save, controllers, frame rate fine). Known issues: close objects can look doubled as you move (45 fps shown twice), busy scenes can slow down, no left-handed or one-controller play.
entries.description: Half-Life: Alyx on Apple Vision Pro itself, with no PC or streaming: Klepton converts the game's ARM64 Linux build into signed visionOS code on your Mac. Install it with the Glovebox Mac app or build it from source, with your own Steam copy. Listed from a copy with an install guide and build fixes.

entries.name: Animal Crossing VR

credits.name: LiquidAzir
credits.role: animal-crossing-vr, the VR mod this port is built on

credits.name: iChris4
credits.role: WiiCompiled Vision, source of the visionOS OpenXR provider

entries.status_notes: Plays in Full and Progressive immersion with PS VR2 Sense controllers, bare hands or a gamepad, and in a 3D window with a gamepad. Played on Apple Vision Pro in the Window view; Full and Progressive tested in the visionOS Simulator.
entries.description: Animal Crossing in six degrees of freedom on Apple Vision Pro: walk your town at life size and swing the net with your own arm, or keep it in a 3D window beside your apps. A native visionOS port of LiquidAzir's VR mod. Bring your own disc.

screenshots.alt: The player outside their house, beside the town's notice board and mailbox, in a window floating in a living room
First person in town: a house with a green roof behind a white fence, fruit trees, a paved path and a notice board, under a blue sky
The same window seen from the side: the notice board and the house stand out of the town behind the glass

entries.name: SHAR VR

credits.name: Svxy
credits.role: The original source code, on GitHub

entries.status_notes: Plays in the Full, Progressive and Window views, with PS VR2 Sense controllers, a gamepad or bare hands. Built and played on Apple Vision Pro.
entries.description: The Simpsons: Hit & Run in six degrees of freedom on Apple Vision Pro. Walk Springfield with a Sense controller in each hand, drive from the driver's seat, or play it as a 3D window beside your other apps. A native visionOS port of kote2345's Hit & Run VR mod.

screenshots.alt: Homer outside 742 Evergreen Terrace, in a window floating in a living room
The same window seen from the side: the scene has real depth behind the glass

entries.name: Dark Eco

credits.name: OpenGOAL
credits.role: GOAL language tools, reconstructed game code and runtime

entries.status_notes: Windowed Jak and Daxter is stable per the developer. This public v2.0 source exposes 2D Comfort mode. The separate experimental immersive build has remaining bugs and is not included in this entry.
entries.description: Native Apple OpenGOAL port with a Dark Eco launcher, on-device import of user-supplied Jak and Daxter data, Metal graphics and controller support. This entry covers the public windowed Vision Pro build.

screenshots.alt: Jak 1 immersive gameplay recorded by Zach on Apple Vision Pro

entries.name: V
entries.status_notes: Windowed play is stable per the developer. Experimental third-person immersion has remaining image-quality, depth-edge, flicker and performance bugs.
entries.description: Native Apple-platform GTA V port built on Muguet, with local ahead-of-time compiled game code, a game window and experimental head-tracked third-person immersion.

screenshots.alt: V — green Vision Pro front glass reflecting a Los Santos sunset

credits.name: Master Chef
credits.role: Executable translation, native runtime, Metal renderer and visionOS port

entries.status_notes: Windowed play is stable per the developer. Immersive mode has remaining bugs; tracked input targets on-foot campaign play. Vehicles and turrets use conventional controls.
entries.description: Native Halo: Combat Evolved port based on Master Chef, with windowed and immersive Vision Pro play, PSVR2 Sense tracked aiming and optional iCloud save sync.

screenshots.alt: Halo gameplay on Vision Pro with a visible hand and PSVR2 Sense controller aiming the assault rifle
A visible PSVR2 Sense controller beneath the sniper scope during gameplay
A visible hand and PSVR2 Sense controller during a grenade throwing gesture

entries.name: AVPcraft
entries.status_notes: Windowed play needs further testing; immersive mode has remaining bugs. The complete build has not yet been repeated from a clean public checkout. See the install guide for known limits.
entries.description: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.2 compiled ahead of time for Vision Pro, with an AVPcraft launcher, windowed play, Vivecraft immersion and PSVR2 Sense input.
